**Record**
<!-- The page URL, e.g. https://islam.museum/en/person/ibn-sina — or the record id, e.g. person/ibn-sina. -->

**What is wrong**
<!-- The exact statement as it stands, and why it is wrong. -->

**The correct fact**
<!-- What the record should say instead. -->

**Source for the correction**
<!-- A citable source: a book (title, author, page), an article, a museum or library record, or a stable link.
     This museum runs on citations — a correction that arrives with a source can be applied as it stands.
     Wikipedia is a useful pointer, but on its own it is not a citable source for prose. -->
